description: This file defines the class `formLetter` which provides server-side methods for handling PDF template management and user interface components for selecting templates within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods to retrieve templates from the database, generate HTML for modal dialogs, and handle user interactions.

classes.name: formLetter
classes.description: A utility class for handling PDF template selection, rendering modal dialogs, and generating related UI components within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: LVSmarty

methods.name: getModuleTemplates
methods.description: Retrieves PDF templates associated with a given module from the database.

methods.name: LVPopupHtml
methods.description: Outputs HTML for a modal dialog listing templates, with options to select or cancel.

methods.description: Outputs HTML for a modal dialog listing templates, with selection handled via a hidden form submission.
